attestations.text: KÊNG Ching-chung 耿精忠, d. 1682, was the eldest son of Kêng Chi-mao [q. v.] and a member of the Chinese Plain Yellow Banner. When still young he accompanied his father on military expeditions, but in 1654 was sent to Peking to wait upon the emperor.
